messages:
maria: Seeing a spike of streaming disconnects after the region-canary last night. Dashboard shows a bunch of `session_timeout` but client logs disagree. Anyone else?
aj: Yup saw alerts. Spike around 02:14-02:20 UTC. Root cause unclear.
sre-bot: ALERT: stream_disconnect_rate > 4% for /v1/stream (eu-west) for 6m. sample_id=abc123
eli: Can you paste a client log sample? Is it an actual TCP timeout or an app-level close?
maria: Client log: ```
ws.onclose { code: 4003, reason: \"connection_closed_by_server\", wasClean: false }
WS-Reconnect: yes
Stack: fetchEventSource -> reconnectWithBackoff
```
aj: Server side shows: ```
[stream-proxy] conn=9876 close_reason=heartbeat_missed src=proxy-48 quota_action=throttle
[router] session_id=xyz lease=stale route=eu-west-2 -> fallback
```
eli: Huh. proxy says `quota_action=throttle` but dashboard labels as `session_timeout`. That mapping is wrong.
console-ux: I'm seeing the same in the console: the chart tooltip is pulling `disconnect_reason` from the session handler but not normalizing proxy-level annotations. So `throttle` becomes `session_timeout` in the UI.
maria: That causes confusion for SRE on-call. They respond to network issues instead of quota/throughput. :disappointed:
aj: Also note we recently tightened client heartbeat expectations in the canary (server now expects pings every 10s instead of 30s). If clients miss that, proxy increments a throttle counter then tears down.
eli: Do we record the 3-tier reasons in telemetry? proxy -> router -> session? I think proxy annotations are being dropped by ingest.
sre-bot: Telemetry ingest error: missing tag `proxy_close_reason` in 02:14 batch (service=stream-metrics-ingest)
maria: Repro steps I used: 1) start a canary client with heartbeat=25s 2) tail proxy logs 3) observe close after ~40s.
sam: Quick suggestion: for now, map `proxy_close_reason:throttle` -> UI label `quota_throttle` and link to quota docs. Less misleading.
console-ux: Agree. I'll make a small change to the labeling logic, but we need a long-term fix: preserve raw annotations through the ingest pipeline and add a column in the session table.
aj: From infra side I want to be careful — the throttle path was intentional to mitigate overload. But the heartbeat change in canary may be too aggressive. Maybe revert canary to 30s while we fix telemetry mapping?
eli: I'd rather keep canary but relax server enforcement to accept pings up to 20s during rollout window. That buys time.
maria: Action items: - console-ux to patch the label mapping (P0 UI patch) - infra (aj) to relax canary heartbeat acceptance to 20s - observability (eli) to add `proxy_close_reason` tag passthrough in ingest - maria to add reproducible test case + timeline to the incident ticket.
console-ux: PR to map labels ready: https://git.internal/redwood/console/pull/4312 (small). Will ship after review.
aj: I'll open infra change: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/changes/987 (allow heartbeat tolerance).
eli: I'll add a telemetry patch and a rollout plan for schema migration. Need ~2 days.
sam: Also consider adding an aggregated metric `throttle_by_reason` in the console to avoid future ambiguity.
maria: One more data point — billing logs show a secondary issue: clients that get `throttle` then reconnect quickly get double-counted for token billing for a short window. We should check dedupe keys on reconnect.
eli: Oof. That could explain odd billing blips last week. Will add to infra ticket.
aj: OK, plan sounds good. Who wants to own the incident ticket?
maria: I'll own it and coordinate. Creating INC-2026 with timeline + all links.
sre-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026 by maria — /incidents/INC-2026
maria: Thanks everyone. Will follow up in the ticket with postmortem template once resolved.
console-ux: Follow-up: I pushed the UI patch to canary. It now surfaces `proxy_close_reason` under advanced details.
aj: Infra change deployed to canary; acceptance to 20s is live. Monitoring for disconnect rate.
eli: Telemetry patch merged to staging, will promote after a smoke test.
maria: Last check (02:57 UTC): disconnect rate dropped to baseline. Closing slack thread, continuing coordination in INC-2026. :white_check_mark:
